explanations.top: Topic marker. Indicates what the sentence is about.
explanations.subj: Subject marker. Indicates who or what performs the action.
explanations.obj: Object marker. Indicates the direct recipient of the action.
explanations.loc: Locative marker. Indicates location or where something is.
explanations.dir: Directional marker. Indicates the direction of movement.
explanations.tim: Time marker. Indicates when an event takes place.
explanations.mns: Means marker. Indicates the tool or method used.
explanations.src: Source marker. Indicates the origin or cause.
explanations.rsn: Reason marker. Explains the 'why' behind an action.
explanations.cnd: Conditional marker. Sets a 'if... then' condition.
explanations.q: Question marker. Turns a statement into a query.
explanations.quo: Quotation marker. Marks thoughts or direct speech.
explanations.emp: Emphasis marker. Adds stress to a specific component.
explanations.ctr: Contrast marker. Highlights differences or oppositions.
explanations.dep: Dependent marker. Links components or creates descriptors.
explanations.tgt: Target marker. Indicates the goal or target of an action.
explanations.cmp: Complement marker. Adds necessary details to the predicate.
explanations.cnj: Conjunction. Joins words or parts of a sentence.
explanations.oth: Special grammar role for this specific context.
explanations.idiom: Phraseological unit. This is a multi-word expression where the combined meaning is different from the literal meaning of each word.
explanations.compound: Compound concept. Multiple source words are merged into a single logical unit in the translation.
explanations.complex_mapping: Complex mapping. Multiple source words are translated using a combined multi-word expression to preserve nuanced meaning.
explanations.extended_translation: Extended translation. A single original word required multiple target-language tokens for a natural and accurate rendering.
explanations.particle: Grammar particle. Defines relationships between words and establishes sentence structure.
explanations.standard_noun: Standard noun. Represents a person, place, thing, or idea in this phrase.
explanations.action_state: Action or state. Describes the activity or condition mentioned in the subtitle.
explanations.vocabulary_default: This word has been prioritized in your library. Its status helps the system highlight it in future content.
